definitions.gloss: minting; coinage; the manufacture of coins and medals
definitions.explanation: The process of producing coins, medals, and similar metal items. Most commonly encountered in the compound {造幣局|ぞうへいきょく} (the Mint).

examples.japanese: ⟦{造幣局|ぞうへいきょく}→造幣局：22023_zouheikyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I visited the Mint on a tour.

examples.japanese: {造幣|ぞうへい}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{偽造|ぎぞう}→偽造：11524_gizou⟧⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進化|しんか}→進化：06029_shinka⟧してきた。
examples.english: Minting technology has evolved to prevent counterfeiting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{造幣局|ぞうへいきょく}→造幣局：22023_zouheikyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通|とお}り{抜|ぬ}け⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: The Osaka Mint is also famous for its cherry blossom walkway.

notes:
Composed of {造|ぞう} (to make, to create) + {幣|へい} (currency, coin). Most often encountered in the compound ⟦{造幣局|ぞうへいきょく}→造幣局：22023_zouheikyoku⟧, Japan's Mint, which has facilities in Osaka, Tokyo, and Hiroshima.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{造幣局|ぞうへいきょく}→造幣局：22023_zouheikyoku⟧: the Mint (Japan Mint)
- {造幣|ぞうへい}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧: minting technology
- {造幣|ぞうへい}⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧: minting operations

CULTURAL NOTE:
The ⟦{造幣局|ぞうへいきょく}→造幣局：22023_zouheikyoku⟧ in Osaka is famous for its annual ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通|とお}り{抜|ぬ}け (cherry blossom passage), a one-week event each April when the public can walk through the grounds to view over 100 varieties of cherry trees. It is one of Osaka's most popular spring events.
